layouts.label: Style axes
layouts.description: Readable axes: grappling, striking and defence scores from the stats.

layouts.label: Similarity
layouts.description: t-SNE: keeps similar fighters together, but the axes have no meaning.

clusters.name: Volume boxers
clusters.description: High-output strikers who head-hunt with their hands; the most knockdowns.

clusters.name: Low-volume all-rounders
clusters.description: Lower striking output; mix in takedowns and some control.

clusters.name: Clinch fighters
clusters.description: Fight in the clinch and to the body, mix in takedowns.

clusters.name: Dominant wrestlers
clusters.description: Most takedowns and control time; do their damage on the ground.

clusters.name: Kickboxers
clusters.description: Kick-heavy strikers: lots of leg and body kicks, rarely shoot for takedowns.
